about: The post-quantum half of the rescue messages (docs/data-sovereignty.md, docs/architecture-v2/pq-suites.md §11): the owner's session order (flagship/rescue-session/v1) and every offline-control order (flagship/offline-control/v1) carry a hybrid-ed25519-mldsa65/v1 signature by the signer's bound key beside the classical one, and the box's hello (flagship/rescue-hello/v1) carries one by the box's STK binding. Same shape and checks as the gate in test-vectors/pq-binding: each case names the binding it uses (null = none), the policy is {profile, rollout}, and `expect` is the verdict of verifyCriticalSignature. ML-DSA signatures are deterministic (rnd = 0^32). Generated by tools/rescue-vectors.ts.
